name: Michael Davis
tagline: Built with love, for Archie — and every child like him.
story: I'm Michael Davis, founder of Sodafom.uk. I built this platform for my son Archie, who was struggling to engage with traditional learning. I wanted something that made education feel like play — not a chore. Drawing on years of experience working with children and families, I designed Sodafom to be the tool I wished existed when Archie was starting out. Every game, every star, every subject has been shaped by watching him learn, grow, and smile.
mission: My mission is simple: give every child the key to unlock their own potential, no matter their starting point. Learning should be joyful, accessible, and something children actually look forward to.
